title: Call behavior of a compiled register program
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each label in $\Lambda$, and let $l_0,l\in\Lambda$ and $ph$ be a phase. The call specification of the register program compiled from $A$ with initial label $l_0$, evaluated at $(l,ph)$, equals the call specification produced directly by applying the instruction at $l$ to phase $ph$.
